source_tree_strategy: Run git ls-files -z; normalize paths to forward slashes; exclude docs/system/**, system-knowledge/**, .tools/baseline/** and any path segment beginning with .stage; sort remaining paths lexicographically; SHA-256 each tracked file in its canonical Git representation (index blob for staged/clean content, current working-tree bytes for an unstaged functional change); concatenate path + NUL + sha256 + LF; SHA-256 the UTF-8 concatenation. Reconstruct commits from their raw Git blob bytes with the same path and aggregation rules.
source_tree_temporary_audit_rule: Exclude any path containing a segment whose basename starts with .stage, regardless of tracked state.
source_tree_scope: Functional product source and configuration only. Baseline knowledge artifacts, baseline tooling and temporary audit files are permanently excluded whether tracked or untracked.
